title: Minna no Shiiku Series 1 - Boku no Kabutomushi (Japan)

fields.name: template_block
fields.evidence: Byte-for-byte match against a verbatim ROM-template memcpy is CONFIRMED_STATIC at the mechanism level, but no byte evidence exists of this block ever containing anything other than the static template, so per-field game semantics (e.g. any individual sub-value being a stat/currency/species id) remain unverified hypotheses.

fields.name: checksum
fields.evidence: Independent Python recomputation against saves/cap-01-future-1.sav reproduces the exact stored byte (0x15); see save-format report section 4 for full script and output.

fields.name: payload
fields.evidence: 82-byte length, RAM buffer address, and all-zero content all match decompiled.c and the real .sav bytes exactly; however since content is always zero in available evidence, no sub-field structure within the payload can be determined.
